schema_sql.chunks:
CREATE TABLE chunks (
    file TEXT NOT NULL,
    chunk_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
    start_line INTEGER NOT NULL,
    end_line INTEGER NOT NULL,
    symbol TEXT,
    symbol_type TEXT,
    chunk_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    text TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (file, chunk_index)
)
schema_sql.chunks_fts: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE chunks_fts USING fts5(content, symbol, path, tokenize='unicode61')
schema_sql.chunks_fts_config: CREATE TABLE 'chunks_fts_config'(k PRIMARY KEY, v) WITHOUT ROWID
schema_sql.chunks_fts_content: CREATE TABLE 'chunks_fts_content'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, c0, c1, c2)
schema_sql.chunks_fts_data: CREATE TABLE 'chunks_fts_data'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, block BLOB)
schema_sql.chunks_fts_docsize: CREATE TABLE 'chunks_fts_docsize'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sz BLOB)
schema_sql.chunks_fts_idx: CREATE TABLE 'chunks_fts_idx'(segid, term, pgno, PRIMARY KEY(segid, term)) WITHOUT ROWID
schema_sql.files:
CREATE TABLE files (
    path TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    size INTEGER NOT NULL,
    chunk_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ok',
    mtime_ns INTEGER,
    inode INTEGER,
    loc INTEGER,
    language TEXT,
    parse_verdict TEXT
)
schema_sql.idx_symbols_file_start: CREATE INDEX idx_symbols_file_start ON symbols(file, start_line)
schema_sql.idx_symbols_id: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_symbols_id ON symbols(id)
schema_sql.imports:
CREATE TABLE imports (
    file TEXT NOT NULL,
    raw_target TEXT NOT NULL,
    resolved_file TEXT,          -- best-effort project-relative resolution
    kind TEXT NOT NULL,          -- import|include|require|use|...
    line INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (file, raw_target, line)
)
schema_sql.index_errors:
CREATE TABLE index_errors (
    file TEXT NOT NULL,
    chunk_index INTEGER,
    error TEXT NOT NULL,
    at REAL NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (file, chunk_index)
)
schema_sql.meta:
CREATE TABLE meta (
    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    value TEXT
)
schema_sql.refs:
CREATE TABLE refs (
    file TEXT NOT NULL,
    line INTEGER NOT NULL,
    from_symbol TEXT,            -- NULL when the reference is module-level
    to_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    relationship TEXT NOT NULL,  -- call|type|base_class|member|includes|identifier
    confidence TEXT NOT NULL,    -- ast | heuristic
    receiver TEXT,               -- member-access receiver as written, else NULL
    target_symbol_id INTEGER,    -- v7: resolved target, NULL until populated
    resolution TEXT,             -- v7: none|same_file|same_project|backend
    PRIMARY KEY (file, line, to_name, relationship)
)
schema_sql.symbols:
CREATE TABLE symbols (
    file TEXT NOT NULL,
    qualified_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    symbol_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    decl_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    container TEXT,
    language TEXT,
    start_line INTEGER NOT NULL,
    end_line INTEGER NOT NULL,
    source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'regex',
    signature TEXT,
    visibility TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (file, qualified_name, symbol_type, decl_hash)
)
